summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload in ESLint plugin
details: The package declares an obfuscated `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) with renamed identifiers and string-map lookups. On install, if `bun` is not already present it downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<archive>.zip` to a tmp directory, chmod +x's the extracted binary, and uses it to `execFileSync` the shipped 727KB `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` begins with `// @bun @bun-cjs` and consists of a single line of heavily obfuscated code — hex/random identifiers, a multi-thousand-entry rotated constants array, and a string-array rotation function `WV8StW`. Running an opaque, heavily obfuscated JS payload via a freshly downloaded alternate runtime at install time is the alternate-runtime-dropper shape, and an ESLint plugin has no legitimate need to execute code under Bun at install. The obfuscation of both the lifecycle script and the sibling payload conceals the resulting behavior on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
